messages:
sam: Hey - console shows canary model v2 at 10% but our logs show almost all traffic still going to v1. Anyone seeing this?

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: service=api-inference, from=v1 -> to=v2, target=10%, id=rollout-20251012-09:00

lee: I pulled logs for the last hour. The router is using consistent hashing on `X-Session-ID` with fallback to `remote_addr`.
lee: current logic (pseudo):
``
key = headers.get('X-Session-ID') or request.remote_addr
bucket = murmur3_32(key) % 100
route = choose_variant_by_bucket(bucket)
```

omar: Found the issue: header normalization mismatch + key canonicalization bug.
omar: Some clients send `x-session-id` (lowercase) and our middleware was checking `X-Session-ID` only, so it fell back to `remote_addr` for those requests. That concentrates traffic on a small set of IPs -> bucket skew.

rachel: Telemetry shows buckets 0-9 consuming ~57% of requests in last 2h. Also some routes hex-decode tokens before hashing while others hash raw bytes.

sam: Repro:
1) curl -H "x-session-id: abc123" https://api.dev/endpoint 1000x
2) curl -H "X-Session-ID: abc123" https://api.dev/endpoint 1000x
Result: same token lands in different buckets ~80% depending on header case.

lee: Mitigation:
- normalize headers to lowercase in gateway
- unify to raw bytes for hashing
- temporary: use random sampling for first 30m of canary to avoid small-sample stickiness

omar: Pushing middleware patch to lowercase headers and consistently encode key bytes. Adding unit tests and e2e for mixed-case headers.

sam: PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4281 — header canonicalization + consistent hashing. Added debug flag to force sampling=random.

deploy-bot: canary rollout updated: rollout-20251012 -> sampling=random for 30m (operator: sam)

rachel: Telemetry work:
- add routing.bucket histogram tagged by rollout_id, model
- rollout.effective_traffic metric
- console panel to show advertised vs effective % and drift alerts

lee: UX proposal:
- Default canary: 10% via random sampling for 30m, then switch to consistent hashing if healthy
- Console should indicate sampling method and allow override

omar: Also adding migration to recompute drift for past 7 days and tests.

rachel: Alert: rollout.drift > 5% should auto-suspend canary and page oncall.

sam: Tasks:
- sam: follow PR + staging deploy (ETA 1h)
- omar: tests + middleware patch
- rachel: dashboard + alert (ETA EOD)
- lee: update rollout UX doc

console-bot: quick-toggle added to rollout UI (experimental). Audit logged.

sam: After deploy we'll run synthetic traffic to validate distribution then flip back to consistent hashing and monitor. Will post short postmortem. :thumbsup:
